name: Upside Arts Overnight Camp
description_short: An overnight theatre camp run by Upside Arts, with theatre training from working industry professionals. Campers also swim, hike, play gaga ball, learn sign language and take workshops.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swimming is listed as an overnight camp activity. The page gives no details about the waterfront or pool.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

source.title: Upside Arts | Theatre Camps and Classes | Portsmouth and Seacoast NH

warnings: The day camp section shows only the 2026 season (Session I: June 22 - July 3; Session II: July 6 - 18; Session III: July 20 - August 1), and those dates have passed. They are not recorded as sessions. The 2027 day camp dates are not posted yet.
The day camp lists ages 7-17. It is not stated whether the same ages apply to the overnight camp.
The page title says 'Portsmouth and Seacoast NH', but the phone number has a Maine (207) area code and the overnight camp's location is not given. No location is recorded.
The camp type is set to sleepaway based on the only 2027 program (Overnight Camp). The organization also runs a theatre day camp, and both are theatre-focused, so 'specialty' could also fit.
